slides.texte_overlay:
Boring money rules every
man should know by 25
Pay yourself first. On payday, move a fixed amount to savings before you spend anything. What's left is your budget. It's boring, and it works every single month.
Keep an emergency fund. Three months of basic costs, untouched. A broken phone or a lost job becomes an annoying week instead of a crisis that ruins your year.
Never borrow for things that lose value. Clothes, holidays, the latest phone. If you can't pay for it now, you can't afford it yet. Wait, save, then buy it.
Know where your money goes. Check your spending once a week for ten minutes. Most men are shocked by what small daily purchases add up to by the end of the month.
Before: no idea how money really worked. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and the curiosity to finally understand things that matter.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: no idea how money really worked. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. Now I have the curiosity to understand what matters.

slides.texte_overlay: Raise your income, not just cut costs. Learn a skill, ask for the raise, take the side project. You can only save so much, but you can keep growing what you earn.
Spend freely on what you love, cut hard on what you don't. Travel, good food, books? Go for it. Subscriptions you forgot about? Cancel them today.
